info.name: inStudiio Backend
info.description:
inStudiio backend API (PRODUCTION), ordered by the user journey. baseUrl defaults to the live Vercel deploy. Set the `jwt` collection variable, then click through:

0. Get a JWT — this is Supabase, NOT this API. Sign in against the prod Supabase project (https://iijhljehoqceownoeauu.supabase.co) with the public anon key and paste the resulting access_token into the `jwt` variable. Raw HTTP: POST {supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with header `apikey: <anon key>` and body {email,password}; use the access_token from the response. (The prod project requires email confirmation before sign-in works. The local `pnpm tsx scripts/mint-test-subscriber.ts` is LOCAL-ONLY testing — it refuses to run against prod — not how the app authenticates.)
1. Health
2. Browse studios (public)
3. Subscribe: POST /subscriptions → open checkoutUrl (test-mode cs_test_…) → pay 4242 4242 4242 4242 → poll GET /me/subscriptions → DELETE /subscriptions/:id
4. Owner upload: POST /studios/:slug/videos → PUT file to Mux uploadUrl
5. Watch: GET /studios/:slug/videos, GET /videos/:id → play https://stream.mux.com/{mux_playback_id}.m3u8

Error shape everywhere: { error: { code, message } }.

⛔ The /webhooks/* requests are documented for reference only — they are called by Stripe/Mux server-to-server and will reject client calls (no valid signature). DO NOT call them from a client.

Production caveats: the prod Stripe test-mode webhook is not registered yet, so on the deployed URL the subscribe loop won't write the subscriptions row — demo the full loop locally with `stripe listen`. CORS_ORIGINS/APP_ORIGIN are currently placeholder example.com, so a web browser frontend won't pass CORS until set (the native iOS app and curl/Postman are unaffected).

variable.description: Supabase access token (JWT) from the prod project iijhljehoqceownoeauu. Get it by signing in: POST https://iijhljehoqceownoeauu.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with header apikey:<anon key> and body {email,password}; copy access_token. In a frontend: session.access_token from supabase-js. Expires in 1h.
A studio UUID (used by POST /subscriptions). Default is the real prod 'Test Studio'.
A studio slug (used by the video endpoints).
A subscription UUID (the `id` from GET /me/subscriptions). Used by DELETE /subscriptions/:id and GET /me/subscriptions/:id.
A video UUID. Used by GET/PATCH/DELETE /videos/:id.

request.description: Public list of studios. → 200 { studios: [...], pagination: { limit, offset, total } }. Keep each studio's `id` (to subscribe) and `slug` (to list its videos). There is NO GET /studios/:slug.

Auth required. Creates a Stripe Checkout Session. → 200 { checkoutUrl }. Redirect the browser to checkoutUrl; user pays with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. Errors: 400 invalid_body, 404 studio_not_found, 409 already_subscribed, 502 stripe_error.

Auth required. The caller's subscriptions. → 200 { subscriptions: [ { id, status, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, studio: {...} } ] }. Poll after checkout until a row with status='active' appears. Only status='active' grants video access.
Auth required. One subscription by id. → 200 { subscription: {...} } or 404 subscription_not_found if it isn't yours.

Auth required. Cancels at period end (NOT instant). → 200 { canceled: true, cancelAtPeriodEnd: true }. User keeps access until current_period_end. Use the SUBSCRIPTION id (from GET /me/subscriptions), not the studio id. Errors: 404 subscription_not_found, 409 not_cancelable.

Auth required AND caller must own the studio. Creates a video row (status 'waiting') and a Mux direct-upload URL. → 201 { video, uploadUrl, uploadId }. Next: PUT the file bytes to uploadUrl (straight to Mux). Errors: 400 bad_request, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 502 upstream_unavailable.

Reference only — this is the Mux direct-upload URL returned by POST /studios/:slug/videos, NOT an inStudiio endpoint. PUT the raw file bytes here. Pick a file in the Body ▸ file tab, paste the uploadUrl, and send. A 200/204 means Mux accepted it; the Mux webhook then flips the video to 'ready'.

query.description: a created_at ISO string for keyset paging

request.description: Auth required — caller must OWN the studio or have an ACTIVE subscription to it. → 200 { videos: [...], nextCursor }. Subscribers see only status='ready' videos; owners see all. Paging: if videos.length === limit, pass nextCursor back as ?cursor=. 403 forbidden if not subscribed.

Auth required — owner or active subscriber. → 200 { video: {...} }. Build playback URL: https://stream.mux.com/{mux_playback_id}.m3u8. NOTE: if not entitled (or not yet 'ready'), returns 404 not_found (NOT 403) — it won't confirm the video exists.
Auth required. Studios OWNED by the caller. → 200 { studios: [...] }.
Auth required, owner only. Edit title and/or description (at least one). → 200 { video: {...} }.
Auth required, owner only. Deletes the video (and its Mux asset). → 204 No Content.

item.name: ⛔ Server-only (DO NOT CALL from a client)

request.description: ⛔ DO NOT CALL. Stripe calls this server-to-server with a signed raw body; it writes the subscriptions row after checkout. A client call has no valid Stripe-Signature and is rejected with 400 invalid_signature. Listed only so you know it exists.

⛔ DO NOT CALL. Mux calls this server-to-server with a signed raw body; it flips videos to 'ready' and stores mux_playback_id. A client call has no valid Mux signature and is rejected with 400 invalid_signature. Listed only so you know it exists.
